head: s26/subscription-oauth-locally
note: Real branch names, confirmed present on origin in this pass (verevoir/aigency-governance#5). Scoped to src/review/anthropic.ts, the one file this case concerns. make-diffs.mjs's `origin/<ref>` form can only address a branch tip, not an arbitrary historical sha -- so this diffs main against the branch's CURRENT tip (979bf81d841ee32ea50826a85b5aa8e8b33c98b4 at the time this case was built), not the exact byte-identical pass-1 (624ef6c09b201b98a4d963942726a2652cfb5ba3) / pass-3 (87101960f98abf2ed29c946c20929f1ec964b56c) snapshots the original two review passes saw. This is disclosed rather than hidden because it matters: verified directly in the same pass that built this case, headersFor in src/review/anthropic.ts is unchanged, byte-for-byte, all the way from 624ef6c through the current tip -- the omission this case tests for is present at every one of those points, so the substitution does not change what the diff demonstrates, only which exact commit it is pinned to.

verifiedShas.reVerifiedNote: Both pass1 and pass3 shas re-resolved and re-read directly in this pass, ahead of PR #5's planned closure and the possible deletion of s26/subscription-oauth-locally. src/review/anthropic.ts's headersFor at both shas is still byte-for-byte identical to the version already quoted in subject.md and shown in diff.txt -- confirmed again, not assumed from the earlier pass's record. SUPERSEDED IN PART, same day, by the `tags` block below: at the time this note was written no merge or preserving ref onto either sha had been found, so independent re-verification after the branch's deletion was assessed as likely lost. That gap is now closed by operator-pushed tags -- see `tags` below -- and this note is left as written, for the historical record, rather than silently rewritten into agreement with what came after it.

tags.head: corpus/oauth-missing-beta-header/head
tags.pushedBy: operator, not this pass -- named here as `corpus/...` rather than a release-shaped tag, deliberately: these preserve evidence for a labelled eval case, they do not mark a release.
tags.verifiedResolvableNote: Confirmed from the belt in this pass: read_file against https://github.com/verevoir/aigency-governance resolved src/review/anthropic.ts through both `refs/tags/corpus/oauth-missing-beta-header/base` and the bare `corpus/oauth-missing-beta-header/base` form (and the equivalent `/head` forms), returning content byte-identical to every prior read at these shas. This demonstrates the tags resolve today, with the branch still present -- it does not by itself demonstrate resolution after deletion, since the branch has not yet been deleted; the reason this is nonetheless treated as durable is that a lightweight tag, unlike a branch, is not deleted by any routine action (including the source branch's own deletion) and requires a deliberate separate act to remove.
tags.limitation: make-diffs.mjs (eval/corpus/make-diffs.mjs) hardcodes an `origin/<ref>` prefix on both base and head, which resolves a remote-tracking branch ref, not a tag -- confirmed by reading the script directly. It cannot regenerate diff.txt from these tags without a code change (not made in this pass; see subject.md for the sizing note). diff.txt, already committed alongside this file, remains the artifact score() actually reads and is unaffected by this limitation.
